column2: aptus Philippines brief target 2, file 1 of 3 — Philippine tax codes
SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition 2608 > Philippines > "Tax Codes for VAT" (deliverable 88520ff2932b479090ed3b7b116b2e91)

This is NOT the source the brief expected. The brief points at the Philippine counterpart of 2608_Pre-configured_Tax_Codes_EN_MY.xlsx. That workbook is not in the repository and the Best Practices content library needs a signed-in session, so it was not read. SAP publishes the same tax-code list anonymously in the Philippines localisation documentation, and that is what this file carries. The workbook additionally carries local-language descriptions, an EU code and an error indicator; those are not published here and the columns are absent rather than blank-filled.
anonymous read of help.sap.com's own published content service (http.svc/deliverableMetadata, http.svc/pagecontent). No login, no scraping.

complete for this source: all 18 rows of SAP's published "Tax Codes for VAT" table. Floor with respect to SAP overall — this table covers VAT only. Withholding tax codes are published separately and are in withholding-tax-codes-ph.tsv beside this file; any tax code SAP predelivers but does not print on this page is not here and its count cannot be measured from this source.
tax-account-assignment-ph.tsv (from the YCOA workbook, an independent source) names 22 distinct Philippine tax codes; 15 of them resolve against this file. UNRESOLVED: S4, S5, S6, SE, SO, V8, V9.
tax_code="Tax Code" · description="Description" · transaction_key="Accounting Key" · tax_type="Tax Type", all verbatim from the published table. country is PH on every row.
reporting_country is empty on every row: this page publishes no reporting country. Empty means not published.
a blank is a blank. Never "N/A", never a substitute.
